I have 3.14 hectares total but this sorghum plot is only 0.34 ha, and sorghum is my food crop so I must be careful with it. The rains here in Oromia lowlands are not always reliable, so I cannot waste money on too much fertilizer — I will buy a small bag of DAP from the cooperative if it arrives in time, and spread some manure from my animals. I will use my own seed from last harvest because improved sorghum seed is hard to find and costly, and sorghum does well enough from local varieties. My wife and older children will help me with weeding and bird-scaring, and I may hire a few neighbors for the heavy weeding if the rains come well.
